    65	def lorentz_distance(x: torch.Tensor, y: torch.Tensor, curvature: float = 1.0) -> torch.Tensor:
    66	    """Stable Lorentz geodesic with a useful straight-through local gradient."""
    67	    if curvature <= 0:

    70	    def exp0(v):

    72	        max_norm = LORENTZ_MAX_TANGENT_NORM / root
    73	        # Differentiable radial projection prevents overflow before cosh/sinh.
    74	        scale = (max_norm / norm).clamp(max=1.0)
    75	        v = v * scale
    76	        norm = norm * scale
    77	        return torch.cat((torch.cosh(root*norm)/root, torch.sinh(root*norm)*v/(root*norm)), dim=-1)
    78	    a, b = exp0(x), exp0(y)

    84	    raw = torch.acosh(arg.clamp_min(1.0 + 1e-7)) / root

   139	def sinkhorn_algorithm(
   140	        distances,
   141	        epsilon,
   142	        sinkhorn_iterations): 
   143	    Q = torch.exp(- distances / epsilon)
   144	
   145	    B = Q.shape[0] # number of samples to assign
   146	    K = Q.shape[1] # how many centroids per block (usually set to 256)
   147	
   148	    sum_Q = Q.sum(-1, keepdim=True).sum(-2, keepdim=True)
   149	    Q /= sum_Q
   150	
   151	    for it in range(sinkhorn_iterations):
   152	        # normalize each column: total weight per sample must be 1/B
   153	        Q /= torch.sum(Q, dim=1, keepdim=True)
   154	        Q /= B
   155	        # normalize each row: total weight per prototype must be 1/K
   156	        Q /= torch.sum(Q, dim=0, keepdim=True)
   157	        Q /= K
   158	    Q *= B # the colomns must sum to 1 so that Q is an assignment
   159	    return Q

   139	def sinkhorn_algorithm(
   140	        distances,
   141	        epsilon,
   142	        sinkhorn_iterations): 
   143	    Q = torch.exp(- distances / epsilon)

   147

   149	    Q /= sum_Q

   152	        # normalize each column: total weight per sample must be 1/B

   154	        Q /= B
   155	        # normalize each row: total weight per prototype must be 1/K
   156	        Q /= torch.sum(Q, dim=0, keepdim=True)
   157	        Q /= K

   159	    return Q
